title: A complex network of interdomain interactions underlies the conformational ensemble of monomeric TDP-43 and modulates its phase behavior.
authors: Mohanty, Priyesh; Rizuan, Azamat; Kim, Young C; Fawzi, Nicolas L; Mittal, Jeetain
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子和粗粒化MD模拟研究TDP-43多结构域蛋白的域间互作网络及其相分离行为，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作蛋白TDP-43，但核心是蛋白自身域间互作与相分离，而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is a multidomain protein involved in the regulation of RNA metabolism, and its aggregates have been observed in neurodegenerative diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Numerous studies indicate TDP-43 can undergo liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) in vitro and is a component of biological condensates. Homo-oligomerization via the folded N-terminal domain (aa:1-77) and the conserved helical region (aa:319-341) of the disordered, C-terminal domain is found to be an important driver of TDP-43 phase separation. However, a comprehensive molecular view of TDP-43 phase separation, particularly regarding the nature of heterodomain interactions, is lacking due to the challenges associated with its stability and purification. Here, we utilize all-atom and coarse-grained (CG) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to uncover the network of interdomain interactions implicated in TDP-43 phase separation. All-atom simulations uncovered the presence of transient, interdomain interactions involving flexible linkers, RNA-recognition motif (RRM) domains and a charged segment of disordered C-terminal domain (CTD). CG simulations indicate these inter-domain interactions which affect the conformational landscape of TDP-43 in the dilute phase are also prevalent in the condensed phase. Finally, sequence and surface charge distribution analysis coupled with all-atom simulations (at high salt) confirmed that the transient interdomain contacts are predominantly electrostatic in nature. Overall, our findings from multiscale simulations lead to a greater appreciation of the complex interaction network underlying the structural landscape and phase separation of TDP-43.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）是一种参与RNA代谢调控的多结构域蛋白，其聚集体已在神经退行性疾病中观察到，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。大量研究表明，TDP-43在体外可发生液-液相分离（LLPS），并且是生物凝聚体的组成部分。通过折叠的N端结构域（aa:1-77）和无序C端结构域的保守螺旋区（aa:319-341）进行的同源寡聚化，被发现是TDP-43相分离的重要驱动因素。然而，由于TDP-43稳定性和纯化方面的挑战，对其相分离的全面分子视角，特别是异源结构域相互作用的性质，仍然缺乏。在本研究中，我们利用全原子和粗粒化（CG）分子动力学（MD）模拟来揭示TDP-43相分离中涉及的域间相互作用网络。全原子模拟揭示了涉及柔性连接区、RNA识别基序（RRM）结构域和无序C端结构域（CTD）带电片段的瞬时域间相互作用的存在。CG模拟表明，这些影响稀释相中TDP-43构象景观的域间相互作用在凝聚相中也普遍存在。最后，序列和表面电荷分布分析结合全原子模拟（在高盐条件下）证实，瞬时域间接触主要具有静电性质。总体而言，我们通过多尺度模拟的发现，加深了对TDP-43结构景观和相分离背后复杂相互作用网络的理解。
